HomeControl for Linux

The HomeControl smart-home controller as a service on a Debian, Raspberry Pi OS or Ubuntu machine: the same controller, web UI and version as the ESP32-C6 firmware, everything but Zigbee. This page is the apt repository of the package homecontrol.

Installation

The distribution follows the system:

SystemDistribution
Debian 12, Raspberry Pi OS (Bookworm), Ubuntu 22.04bookworm
Debian 13, Raspberry Pi OS (Trixie), Ubuntu 24.04 and newertrixie

The channel stable holds the releases, beta the pre-releases as well (the update channels of the firmware). For Trixie and @CHANNEL@:

sudo curl -fsSLo /usr/share/keyrings/homecontrol-archive-keyring.gpg \
  @SITE_URL@/homecontrol-archive-keyring.gpg
echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/homecontrol-archive-keyring.gpg] @SITE_URL@ trixie @CHANNEL@" \
  | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/homecontrol.list
sudo apt update
sudo apt install homecontrol

apt picks the architecture (amd64, arm64 and armhf are published). The service starts at once: open http://<host>:8081/ and set the controller's password.

Setup and updates

Port, data, logs and what Linux does not offer: doc/linux.md. Updates come with sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade; the settings and the runtime image stay.
